differences.what: Titled Sexual and reproductive health. A Medical note type, sensitive, in the clinical timeline group.
Choose-many. Other asks for a short text. Pregnancy, Contraception and Menstrual each show a section.
The pregnancy test is first in the section, Positive or Negative: Not done is left out.
LMP is one answer, in a section of its own shown when Pregnancy or Menstrual is picked, with the flag Approximate. The date is in the past; 09 / 12 / 2026 is an example.
Beside the pregnancy test, a flag the lines do not have: Known pregnancy, no test today. A pregnancy known before this visit opens Current pregnancy without a test being recorded that was not done.
differences.why: inventory A44; PRD main 417; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): a departure from the lines, for the clinical team to confirm

differences.what: Choose-one. Other asks for a short text. A patient using two methods (the pill and condoms) records one.
differences.why: inventory A1, A2; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): choose-one or choose-many (A1 lists the line among the least certain)

differences.what: If [ Menstrual Health ] is the reason Menstrual.
The menstrual block's LMP is the one LMP answer, in the section Last menstrual period.
Typical cycle and typical duration are empty whole numbers of days: cycle 1 to 90, duration 1 to 30. 28 and 5 are examples.
differences.why: PRD main 420; inventory A49; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the ranges

differences.what: Pain is an empty whole number out of 10; 4 / 10 is an example.
